steps.operator_notes: Wix page lists many unrelated PDFs (Pastoral Plan, Directory, Supreme Court ruling, Gaza statement, magazine) under opaque hashed /_files/ugd/ URLs with no date info, so the generic *.pdf fallback used to grab whichever link happened to score highest (or, before the hash-date bug fix, a coincidentally date-like hash). The 'Weekly bulletin' section always has a currently-valid sheet literally titled 'Mass Times up to <date>' (a second, future-dated 'Mass Times from <date> onwards' sheet is often listed too — do not just take the newest/last match). If this selector ever stops matching, fail loud and retrain rather than falling back to *.pdf.
